## Hazards

- [S1] rough: gh repo create --clone put repo inside caddystack dir
- [S1] bunker: Dynamic import path in builder.test.ts missed by sed batch replacement
- [S1] bunker: Missing @types/node in CLI package, strict TS needed return after process.exit
- [S2] rough: Sprint resolution needed fallback chain: --sprint flag → config → latest scorecard + 1
- [S4] rough: core missing @types/node — required adding devDep
- [S4] rough: mcp-tools resolved published core v0.3.3 instead of workspace — switched to workspace:* protocol
- [S6] rough: better-sqlite3 native build required pnpm approve-builds; worked around via package.json onlyBuiltDependencies
- [S6] bunker: initCommand became async — broke 5 existing tests that called it synchronously without await
- bunker: Dynamic imports in test files can be missed by batch sed replacements
- bunker: CLI packages need @types/node explicitly — not inherited from monorepo root
- bunker: process.exit() doesn't narrow types in strict TS — add return after for type safety
- bunker: Sprint resolution fallback chain (flag → config → scorecard inference) is duplicated in claim.ts and briefing.ts
- bunker: ApiRegistry has no test coverage — don't switch registry mode to 'api' without adding tests first

## Acceptance criteria

Each ticket lands on `main` via PR with:
- typecheck + tests green
- review-amend findings recorded
- scorecard validated

## Suggested commit boundaries

One commit per ticket; bundled-commit only when tickets share files and tests run together. Conventional-commit prefix mirrors ticket type (feat/fix/chore).
